title: A Echo for the Protocol
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
